description: NaH₂SO₄CF₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of four CF₃ clusters and two NaH₂SO₄ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. In each CF₃ cluster, C is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent F atoms. All C-F bond lengths are 1.36 Å. F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In each NaH₂SO₄ sheet, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.47 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.46 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom.
